head_commit.message:
Preserve `invalid_prompt` as a distinct error classification (#47353)

## Why

`invalid_prompt` responses were classified as generic invalid requests, losing the server's specific error classification.

## What changed

Add `InvalidPrompt` variants to the API and core error types and serialize the core protocol classification as `invalid_prompt`. Recognize the code in HTTP 400 responses, wrapped WebSocket errors, and SSE `response.failed` events while preserving server messages and keeping the error non-retryable. Map it to `other` in the app-server v2 protocol.

## Testing

Extend coverage for typed error mapping, missing and blank messages, protocol conversion, and guardian retry handling. Exercise HTTP and SSE failures in core integration tests, asserting the error message, serialized classification, and a single request without retry.

GitOrigin-RevId: 5d9a299a013b06158a4dc27a4054f3dbc5fd0f4d

head_commit.message:
Reuse cloud skill catalogs across turns until invalidated (#47350)

## Why

Cloud skill discovery ran on every turn, even when the Apps resource generation and authentication scope were unchanged.

## What changed

- Reuse warning-free catalogs, including empty catalogs, while their authentication scope and Apps resource cache key remain current.
- Refresh after invalidation and retry failed or partial discovery on the next turn.
- Reject discovery results if the Apps resource cache key changes during discovery.

## Testing

Update lifecycle tests to verify cached turns avoid catalog listings and skill reads, while connection and authentication changes trigger refreshes. Update the referenced-resource test to verify partial discovery retries on the next turn without an explicit MCP refresh.

head_commit.message:
Reuse cloud skill catalogs across turns until invalidated (#47350)

## Why

Cloud skill discovery ran on every turn, even when the Apps resource generation and authentication scope were unchanged.

## What changed

- Reuse warning-free catalogs, including empty catalogs, while their authentication scope and Apps resource cache key remain current.
- Refresh after invalidation and retry failed or partial discovery on the next turn.
- Reject discovery results if the Apps resource cache key changes during discovery.

## Testing

Update lifecycle tests to verify cached turns avoid catalog listings and skill reads, while connection and authentication changes trigger refreshes. Update the referenced-resource test to verify partial discovery retries on the next turn without an explicit MCP refresh.

head_commit.message:
Overlap subagent spawn persistence and clean up cancelled children (#47348)

## Why

Forked subagent startup serializes history persistence and spawn-edge writes. Cancellation during startup can also leave a provisional child behind.

## What changed

- Defer copied-history durability so it can run alongside spawn-edge persistence, while still awaiting both before submitting the child's initial input.
- Commit agent and residency reservations and notify clients only after initial input is accepted.
- Guard provisional children so cancellation or startup failure removes and shuts them down, discards their stored state, and closes their spawn edge after any pending edge write finishes.

## Testing

Add coverage for cancellation at the child-history durability barrier, checking child termination, removal, and edge closure. Extend fork-context tests in legacy and paginated history modes to verify inherited context can be read from storage after spawn acknowledgment without flushing the live child first.

head_commit.message:
Add GPT-6 Sol and Luna to Amazon Bedrock catalogs (#47347)

## What changed

Add `openai.gpt-6-sol` and `openai.gpt-6-luna` to the Bedrock catalog, including `global.` and `us.` variants for Bedrock Runtime. Make GPT-6 Sol the default and provider fallback model, preferring its global variant for Runtime. Retain the existing models and update model picker ordering.

## Testing

Extend catalog and provider tests to cover the new models, metadata, ordering, and default selection. Update thread-start tests for supported model preservation and fallback behavior, and refresh Mantle and Runtime model picker snapshots.

Skip stored title lookups for ephemeral forks (#47342)
